claim_label: AI Development: Competitive Industry vs. Public Utility
description: This conflict examines whether AI should be managed as a competitive industrial process focused on innovation or as a regulated public utility to ensure societal accountability.

instances.assertion: Development should be treated as an industrial discipline where speed is balanced by empirical safety standards to ensure human progress.
Development must be treated as a public utility to prevent corporate capture and ensure accountability for labor and societal harms.
